correctness.description: The change solves the stated behavior without known regressions.

verification.description: Relevant tests, builds, smoke checks, or manual checks already ran.

scope_control.description: The change is narrow, avoids unrelated churn, and respects dirty worktrees.

maintainability.description: The implementation follows local patterns and remains easy to review.

rollback_clarity.description: The report identifies changed surfaces and how to revert or isolate risk.

task_fit.description: The UI solves the requested workflow rather than adding decorative surface.

visual_hierarchy.description: Layout, spacing, type scale, and information hierarchy are coherent.

responsive_stability.description: Desktop/mobile views avoid overlap, overflow, and layout jumps.

interaction_completeness.description: Controls, empty states, errors, loading, and expected interactions are present.

verification.description: Browser smoke, console check, screenshots, or equivalent evidence exists.

answer_relevance.description: The report directly answers the user's question.

source_quality.description: Claims are backed by primary or reliable sources.

uncertainty_disclosure.description: Unknowns, assumptions, and time-sensitive facts are clearly marked.

actionability.description: The report ends in concrete choices or next actions.

role_boundary.description: TL, leader, and worker responsibilities are explicit and not blurred.

non_silent_failure.description: Fallbacks, uncertainty, and failed worker outputs are visible.

handoff_quality.description: Each layer passes task, evidence, risk, and acceptance criteria forward.

observability.description: The workflow leaves inspectable traces, statuses, and enough debug context.

calibration.description: Rubrics or examples exist so judgment does not depend on one model sample.
